title: Bind split mutable incumbent entrypoint provenance

incident_reproduction_analysis.cause: The clean 0305c861 candidate was aborted because live PID 1393542 had cwd /home/lupin/pantheon-ci-deploy/dev-root while its configured supervisor_command executed /home/lupin/pantheon-ci-deploy/command-runtimes/5877b64425c8d6aede147d6cbbc6fbb9e228c259/.orchestrator/supervisor.py. Discovery failed because ExpectedSupervisorProcessContract.command_root was hardcoded to cwd instead of entrypoint_root.
incident_reproduction_analysis.repair: Updated _mutable_process_contract to set ExpectedSupervisorProcessContract.command_root=str(entrypoint_root), binding the legacy split expected contract to the descriptor-validated entrypoint-root identity in capture, prepare baseline, and transaction revalidation. Added live-like positive test and adversarial wrong-command-root test while keeping candidate/rollback single-root contracts strict.

safety_and_coherence_invariants.split_root_provenance: When cwd and entrypoint_root differ for a legacy mutable incumbent, both roots are validated independently for Git HEAD, tree, remote URL/slug (ajoe734/pantheon), accepted origin/dev ancestry, cleanliness, and governed launch source byte equality (sha256/byte_length). PANTHEON_COMMAND_ROOT in environment matches the descriptor-validated entrypoint_root. Any mismatch aborts immediately.
safety_and_coherence_invariants.strict_rejection_boundaries: Relative entrypoints, multiple supervisor.py arguments, symlinks/path traversal in entrypoint path or root, dirty tracked files, untracked/ignored debris outside allowlist, commit/tree mismatches between roots, wrong PANTHEON_COMMAND_ROOT, and launch source byte drift are rejected.
safety_and_coherence_invariants.clean_rollback_materialization: Rollback launches use a separately materialized 100% clean immutable checkout from the descriptor-bound accepted commit/tree in command-runtimes/. Neither dirty live root is ever relaunched from or mutated.
safety_and_coherence_invariants.launch_identity: Governed launch source contracts, config CAS, process signalling, -B / PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, 3-loop postchecks, and promotion lock boundaries remain intact.

no_live_rollout_boundary: This task is source-only. No live config edits, direct process signals, live runtime promotions, candidate deletions, canonical state edits, or fleet scheduling changes were performed.
